title: The Item Was Bent
text: The Item Was Bent. My package arrived in perfect time, but ended up not even mattering...I open the package to find the main basket, the hanging parts for the door, and the entire right side were smashed in, bent, uneven, and completely damaged. What a dissappointment..was looking forward to this!

product_metadata.title: Spectrum Diversified Basket Grid Wide Hair Styling Station, Over the Cabinet Door, Bronze, Medium
features: HOOKS FOR STYLING TOOLS: Keep your styling tools neatly tucked away in this convenient basket. Hooks are included to hold your flat irons, curling wands, round brushes, and more. Loop on the side is designed to support the barrel or handle of a standard-sized blow dryer. Wide basket holds all your favorite styling products, so you can keep your hairspray, heat protectant spray, leave-in conditioner, and more nearby while you work.

FARMHOUSE FASHION FOR STORAGE & ORGANIZATION: Cross-wire design invites your farmhouse style into your bathroom. With clean lines and rustic finishes, the organizer adds a bit of style to your overall bathroom scheme.

UTILIZE DEAD SPACE: Use open space within cabinets for storage! Keep cleaning supplies, washcloths, hand towels, and more inside your kitchen or bathroom cabinets. The sturdy design can also hold makeup, medicine, sponges, bath bombs, candles, or personal care items.

AVOID INSTALLATION: Add extra storage without all the hardware. Padded brackets slide easily over cabinet doors for quick, no fuss installation. No tools required. Perfect for apartments, rental homes, or RVs.
DIMENSIONS & CARE: 7.75" L X 14" W X 14.5" H; to clean, wipe with a damp cloth and towel dry.
